result.title: Data-free Multistep Diffusion Distillation
result.summary: One-step diffusion distillation achieves strong performance on small datasets but remains insufficient for high-resolution or complex text-to-image settings. Extending to multistep distillation often requires training data, suffers from early-step degradation, inconsistent outputs across sampling budgets, and incurs high computational cost. We identify that these limitations stem from simultaneous training, where a single adapted network approximates multiple score functions of different student distributions at once, causing biased distribution matching and unstable optimization. Therefore, we propose Progressive Multistep Data-free Distillation (PMDD), which assigns a dedicated adapted network per student distribution while avoiding the memory overhead of maintaining multiple adapted networks. Combined with a stage-wise unforget loss to preserve earlier-step generations, PMDD reduces optimization bias in the student, provides faster convergence, and a single unified model that supports multiple inference budgets. Extensive experiments show that PMDD matches or outperforms data-free few-step baselines at every multistep budget, reaches FID 1.99 on ImageNet 64x64 in two steps, below its 512-NFE teacher (2.32), and achieves FID 7.76 on zero-shot COCO 512x512, while requiring 4-5x less training compute than data-free DMDv2 to support three inference budgets.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 PMDD，一种无数据多步扩散蒸馏方法：为每个学生分布分配专用的适配网络（同时避免多网络的内存开销），并引入分段式 unforget 损失保留早期步的生成结果，从而减少分布匹配偏差、加快收敛，并用单一模型支持多种推理预算。
AI.relevance_reason: 该工作本身属扩散图像生成，与 LVR 无直接关系；但其「按步分阶段训练 + 保留早期步生成」的监督设计和「单一模型覆盖多个推理预算」可能可供核查 LVR 中多步轨迹训练、早期状态遗忘与动态计算/长度泛化的训练方案。
